images.title: Mercy Made Visible
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: nature photograph for a sermon page and its archive thumbnail on Cat Connolly's website.
Primary request: A clear shallow stream winding beside wildflowers and soft green grasses; water visibly nourishing the flowers along its banks.
Style/medium: realistic fine-detail nature photography, calm and contemplative, matching the understated natural photographs already used on the site.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:9; keep the main subject clear near the central area so a centered nearly square thumbnail crop also works. One continuous photograph.
Lighting/mood: soft natural daylight, believable colors and textures, gentle hopefulness.
Constraints: no text, lettering, logos, watermarks, borders, collage, people, buildings, or religious symbols. Opaque background.
